chamber.rule: 218 of 435 seats (a majority of the whole House)
chamber.seat_model: y_i = mean_i + swing_loading_i * d + e_i, d ~ N(0, common_swing_sd^2), e_i ~ N(0, own_sd_i^2), each seat's stage_two.inputs giving mean, own_sd, swing_loading

model.what: the model's own forecast (data/congress/REPORT.md section 2), fitted on earlier cycles only, from what was known before the election (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 05:58); no polls are used, so it carries less than forecasters then knew

calibration.note: k = the root mean square of z = (y - mean) / sd over these earlier years' races, each year forecast from its own earlier cycles, the means shrunk toward 1/2 by this year's shrinkage factor

model.sd_is: sqrt(national_sd^2 + s_e^2); national_sd = k s_a sqrt(1 + z (Z'Z)^-1 z'), s_e = k s_e_fitted, z = (1, midterm * P, (1 - midterm) * P), P = +1 Democratic president, -1 Republican; k the calibration factor

shrink.what: mean = 1/2 + factor (the fitted mean - 1/2); factor the slope through 1/2 of the result on the mean over these earlier years' raw out-of-sample forecasts, weighted by 1/sd^2

variant.note: the mean shrunk toward 1/2 by the factor fitted on earlier years, k refitted on the shrunk means, normal tails first (REPORT 2.7)

by_band.of: the house's own earlier years, |mean - 1/2| from 0.00 to 0.05
the house's own earlier years, |mean - 1/2| from 0.05 to 0.10

near_tie.note: a factor by band of |mean - 1/2| (band_from up to the next band's start): each forecast's own calibration gives its multiplier of p; a band whose fitting years expected fewer than 30 near-ties has none (REPORT 2.6, 2.7)
